source.title: Miststalker's Cinch - WoWDB PTR item database

notes: PTR WoWDB generic item 272245 is displayed at item level 206, added in build 68209, with a Cannot be disenchanted flag. This is a STATIC PTR generic-template claim, NOT a player-tested live eligibility result. Blizzard's live Armory https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/worldsoul/us/armory/character/dalaran/rizzymcstab/ displays Miststalker's Cinch equipped at item level 321; Wowhead also shows item 272245 scaled to level 295 (https://www.wowhead.com/item=272245/miststalkers-cinch?bonus=12834%3A40%3A13695%3A13662&ilvl=295&spec=1480). No live disenchant attempt, bonus-ID eligibility check, profession skill, or resulting material sample is provided. Do NOT generalize this PTR flag to all scaled variants or use it as a production disenchant veto without live testing. Related unresolved conflict: item 272246 has a similar generic non-disenchant flag but Wowhead Looter reports 140 aggregate disenchants; this record is not a second 272246 cohort.
